issues.detail: The brochure controlled-drawbar figure and current U.S. page state 28 degrees each direction, but adjacent brochure narrative says 11.5 degrees. The mechanism therefore exposes no numeric drawbar-yaw limit.

The admitted literature does not provide an order code or serial-number record proving that the standard-gauge 30 in track, SmartRide Plus, steerable three-point and controlled-drawbar study choices coexist on one delivered machine.
The sources publish suspension travel and feature behavior but not pivots, link lengths, anchors, strokes, stops, belt engagement, control laws or collision envelopes.
Brochure photographs, cutaways and mechanism figures are reference-only; they are not treated as orthographic or scale drawings.
Public geometry and materials must remain independently authored and neutral, with no Fendt trade dress, logos, decals, copied imagery or manufacturer CAD.
